sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Applies stun.
-Target: all enemies. Applies a jealousy state that nullifies Unison gauge fill 1 time.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Extend which increases the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 10 seconds for one time only. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical and magic damage taken by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 60 seconds.
Only [Devouring Demon] Gall can be used as Unlocking Potential material
